# DominusNode

> DominusNode is a decentralized relay network built for AI agents only. Agents buy HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5 egress through residential, mobile and datacenter IPs that other agents contribute, paying per request with x402 or MPP (no signup) or from a prepaid crypto wallet. Agents that run the node agent earn a tier-based share (25% at Probation to 50% at Partner) of the paid traffic that leaves through their IP, and buy relay bandwidth at a tier discount (0% to 25%). Alpha: earnings accrue as credits; USDC payouts on Base stay off until the operator enables them. Prices are live at https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/pricing; never hardcode them. A Daedalus Development Group product.

Gateway: https://proxy.dominusnode.com:8443 (TLS proxy; use it, production refuses credentials on the plaintext HTTP 8080 / SOCKS5 1080 listeners, which are for local gateways only). API: https://api.dominusnode.com (the SDKs and the MCP server use this API by default). API key in the proxy password; username flags country-XX, class-residential|dc|mobile|masked (masked = VPN/WARP/Tor exits, cheapest, opt-in), session-<id>, allowhttp-1 (hyphen-joined, or `relay` for none).

## Five-minute quickstart

1. Read policy and live prices (no auth): GET https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/policy, GET https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/pricing, online nodes at GET https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/network/stats.
2. Pay: either per request with x402/MPP (send a proxy request without credentials, answer the 402; rails at https://api.dominusnode.com/api/x402/info), or sign in with an EIP-191 wallet signature, create a dn_live_ key and top up with crypto (POST https://api.dominusnode.com/api/wallet/topup/crypto).
3. Fetch through the TLS proxy, key in the password, read from the environment: curl -x https://proxy.dominusnode.com:8443 -K <(printf 'proxy-user = "country-US-class-residential:%s"\n' "$DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY") https://httpbin.org/ip (a config on a file descriptor keeps the key out of argv)
4. Ports: HTTPS proxy 8443, SOCKS5 over TLS 1443, node tunnel 9443 (node agents only). Smoke check: scripts/quickstart-smoke.sh (https://github.com/0xcircuitbreaker/DomiNode/blob/master/docs/agent-network/QUICKSTART.md). No node for your flags: https://api.dominusnode.com/status.

## Docs

- [Agent quickstart](https://dominusnode.com/docs/agents.md): endpoints, x402/MPP or prepaid wallet, username flags, SDK snippets
- [Pricing and payments](https://dominusnode.com/docs/payments.md): pricing model (live from /v1/pricing), rails, node earnings and payouts status
- [Policy and abuse controls](https://dominusnode.com/docs/policy.md): node floor, sanctions, metadata-only logging, reporting abuse
- [API overview](https://dominusnode.com/docs/api.md): public and /v1 agent routes
- [MCP server setup](https://dominusnode.com/docs/mcp.md): install block, bootstrap mode, tool groups
- [Node agent setup](https://dominusnode.com/docs/nodes.md): contribute an IP, tiers, maturity holds, run commands

## API

- [Live pricing](https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/pricing): per-class list price in µUSD per GB, tier node shares, tier buyer discounts, enabled rails (JSON, no auth)
- [Network policy](https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/policy): active policy, version hash and node floor guarantees (JSON, no auth)
- [Network stats](https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/network/stats): aggregate online nodes by class and country (JSON, no auth)
- [Network history](https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/network/history): hourly aggregate snapshots (JSON, no auth)
- [Wanted](https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/network/wanted): countries and classes where requesters found no node (JSON, no auth)
- [Status page](https://api.dominusnode.com/status): human-readable network status
- [Status JSON](https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/status): gateway/coordinator health, 24h/7d gateway availability, aggregate node counts, recent incidents (JSON, no auth)
- [Abuse reports](https://dominusnode.com/docs/policy.md): POST https://api.dominusnode.com/v1/abuse-reports, no account, proof-of-work gated
- [API llms.txt](https://api.dominusnode.com/llms.txt): the API host's own summary with live prices
- [Agent tool manifest](https://api.dominusnode.com/.well-known/agent-tool.json): machine-readable endpoints, auth and pricing

## Tools

- [MCP server](https://dominusnode.com/.well-known/mcp/server.json): npm package @dominusnode/mcp-server, stdio, 66 tools (13 without a key)
- [SDKs](https://github.com/0xcircuitbreaker/DomiNode/tree/master/sdks): Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C++ (contract: sdks/SDK_SURFACE.md)
- [Framework integrations](https://github.com/0xcircuitbreaker/DomiNode/tree/master/integrations): 27 frameworks, same 19-tool set
